subject.title: fix(reply): strip leaked current-message scaffolding and (no output) placeholders

question: Should maintainers accept this shared reply-sanitizer and `empty-tool-output` skip-reason contract once the behind branch and broad CI failures are handled?
rationale: The code review did not find a discrete patch bug, but changing shared final-delivery sanitization can affect every channel that uses `normalizeReplyPayload`, so this is a maintainer acceptance decision rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Accept After Rebase And Clean/Triaged CI
options.body: Refresh the branch against current main, rerun or triage the two broad failed shards, and merge if the shared delivery semantics are accepted.

options.title: Request Live Telegram Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short Telegram proof if maintainers want visible transport confirmation beyond production-function terminal output.

options.title: Pause For Different Sanitizer Semantics
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a narrower marker contract or different owner boundary for leaked prompt scaffolding.
